exam_scheme.note: The National Board for Higher Mathematics (NBHM), Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, conducts the nationwide Doctoral Scholarship Screening Test. The test evaluates advanced mathematical understanding across algebra, analysis, geometry, topology, and applied mathematics. It serves two distinct purposes: (1) grant of prestigious NBHM Doctoral Fellowships (₹37,000/month JRF for 2 years, ₹42,000/month SRF for subsequent years plus contingency grant of ₹40,000/year), and (2) primary screening for Ph.D. / Integrated Ph.D. admissions at premier research institutions including IMSc Chennai, HRI Prayagraj, NISER Bhubaneswar, and IISERs.
